description: This Java source file implements data access object (DAO) methods for managing User entities in the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations, password management, and search functionalities, specifically using Hibernate ORM.

classes.name: HibernateUserDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the UserDAO interface, providing methods for user data persistence, retrieval, and management within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves or updates a User object in the database. If the user is new and a password is provided, it hashes the password, updates credentials, and flushes the session.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User object by username or systemId, excluding retired users.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a User by email address in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: getLoginCredentialByActivationKey
methods.description: Retrieves LoginCredential based on an activation key, decoding and matching the key.

methods.name: hasDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Checks whether the username or systemId (with optional check digit validation) is already used by another user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Gets a User by their userId.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Returns all non-daemon users, ordered by userId.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from the database.

methods.name: getUsersByRole
methods.description: Fetches users associated with a specified role.

methods.name: getAllPrivileges
methods.description: Retrieves all privileges available in the system.

methods.name: getPrivilege
methods.description: Fetches a Privilege object by privilege name.

methods.name: deletePrivilege
methods.description: Deletes a privilege.

methods.name: savePrivilege
methods.description: Saves or updates a privilege.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role.

methods.name: saveRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a role.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles ordered by role name.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Fetches a role by role name.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes a user's password, verifying caller origin, encoding, and updating credentials.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password with pre-hashed password and salt.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on name and roles, with optional pagination.

methods.name: generateSystemId
methods.description: Generates a new system user ID by incrementing the maximum existing user ID.

methods.name: getUsersByName
methods.description: Retrieves users matching given name fragments, optionally including retired users.

methods.name: getPrivilegeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches Privilege by UUID.

methods.name: getRoleByUuid
methods.description: Fetches Role by UUID.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves User by UUID.

methods.name: getLoginCredential
methods.description: Retrieves LoginCredential for a user.

methods.name: getLoginCredentialByUuid
methods.description: Fetches LoginCredential by UUID.

methods.name: updateLoginCredential
methods.description: Updates or saves login credential information.

methods.name: getUsersByPerson
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific Person entity.

methods.name: getCountOfUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching specified criteria.

methods.name: setUserActivationKey
methods.description: Sets activation key for a user.

methods.name: getLastLoginTime
methods.description: Fetches last login timestamp property for a user.
